result.topic_en: Series expansion of log tan(p/2) for p = q - h sin q with h a cosine series, applied to derive the conversion between geodetic latitude ψ and an auxiliary latitude ω via log tan(45°+ω/2), with numerical evaluation of the coefficients in seconds.
result.transcription:
Band IX S. 191
Ist $p = q - h\sin q$
so wird
$\log\,\mathrm{tg}\,\tfrac12 p = \log\,\mathrm{tg}\,\tfrac12 q - h - \tfrac12 hh\cos q$
$- \tfrac16 h^3(2-\sin q^2) - \tfrac1{24}h^4\cos q(6-\sin q^2)\ldots$

Ist $h = a\cos q + b\cos 3q + c\cos 5q + d\cos 7q$ so wird
$\log\,\mathrm{tg}\,\tfrac12 p = \log\,\mathrm{tg}\,\tfrac12 q$
$-\cos q\,(a + \tfrac38 aa + \tfrac14 ab + \tfrac14 bb + \tfrac{11}{24}a^3 + \tfrac{9}{32}aab + \tfrac{235}{1536}a^4)$
$-\cos 3q\,(b + \tfrac18 aa + \tfrac12 ab + \tfrac14 ac + \tfrac3{16}a^3 + \tfrac7{16}aab + \tfrac{121}{1536}a^4)$
$-\cos 5q\,(c + \tfrac14 ab + \tfrac18 bb + \tfrac12 ac + \tfrac1{48}a^3 + \tfrac14 aab + \tfrac{9}{512}a^4)$
$-\cos 7q\,(d + \tfrac18 bb + \tfrac14 ac + \tfrac1{32}aab + \tfrac1{1536}a^4)$

In unserm Beispiel
$a = -4ff - 10f^4 - \tfrac{40}{3}f^6 + \tfrac{1247}{9}f^8$
$b = +\tfrac23 f^4 + \tfrac{44}{3}f^6 + \tfrac{1897}{15}f^8$
$c = -\tfrac{68}{15}f^6 - \tfrac{3253}{45}f^8$
$d = +\tfrac{4397}{315}f^8$
Daraus wird zuletzt abgeleitet (in unsern Zeichen)

$\log\,\mathrm{tang}\,(45^\circ+\tfrac12\omega) = \log\,\mathrm{tang}\,(45^\circ+\tfrac12\psi)$
$-\sin\psi\,(4ff + 4f^4 + \tfrac{40}{3}f^6 - 22f^8$
$-\sin 3\psi\,(\tfrac83 f^4 + \tfrac{34}{3}f^6 + 59f^8$
$-\sin 5\psi\,(\tfrac{98}{15}f^6 + \tfrac{247}{3}f^8$
$-\sin 7\psi\,(\tfrac{400}{21}f^8$

$4ff = 10490.4525992$
$4f^4 = 4.3257580\,93$
$\tfrac{40}{3}f^6 = 0.0059429\,49$
$-22f^8 = -0.0000040\,42$
